newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume plunges to 270 kilos.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume plunges to 270 kilos.

text.p: The Istanbul gold exchange volume slumped to 270 kilos on Thursday from Wednesday's record of 3,870 kilos on Wednesday.
Dealers said activity was extremely dull after Wednesday's heavy arbitrage transactions which pushed up the volume.
All of the trade was made in lira terms and in the first session.
Gold closed lower at 1,439,800 lira per gram, versus 1,446,500 on Wednesday on downward world prices.
The Turkish currency closed easier at 127,950 from 127,850 Wednesday.
Wednesday's dollar close was $352.00 an ounce.
